title: SIMAI Framework shared name registry
description: The one public registry of Smart component names (standard simai.component-set): which owner, SIMAI Framework or one component set, holds each name family under the one prefix sf-, and the names known in each family. It holds names only: no files, versions, rules, relations or bytes. A family has one owner; a name starts with a family its owner holds. It is read from simai/ui-source main, the one documented exception to main is not a contract, so a set's CI needs no SIMAI Framework release to check against it.

status.description: planned: the set is decided but its repository does not release under simai.component-set yet; its families and names are reserved. pending: the set awaits the owner's decision; its families are held for it so no other owner takes them meanwhile.

note.description: Optional: why the entry is pending or planned, with its decision reference.

source.description: Where the names were read from when the entry was last refreshed.

exceptions.description: Names that break the family rule today and are waiting for a decision. Each is explicit, dated and has an owner of the fix; a gate refuses any break not listed here.

family_owner.description: Who owns the element's family in this registry.
